sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Current Ratio Liquidity: Current assets cover current liabilities 0.93 times. Liquidity is tight relative to short-term obligations.

Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +19.1% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 31 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -2.8% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.
